appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015'.
A single blue line plots population over time.
The line begins at the year 2010, at a population value of 2000.
The line ends at the year 2015, at a population value of 3000.

public_definitions: Review the City A population dashboard for 2010-2015, then choose the follow-up route for the population planning workflow.
Use the City A population dashboard as the evidence source for the population trend routing decision.
Population trend route: Route to population growth planning, Route to population decline response, Keep on routine population monitoring.
